name: unsafe fn awaken (self) -> & 'a mut T
rule: For `DormantMutRef::awaken` to be safe, the reborrow must have ended: the reference returned by `new` and all pointers and references derived from it must not be used anymore.
api: impl < 'a , T > alloc::collections::btree::borrow::DormantMutRef < 'a , T > { unsafe fn awaken (self) -> & 'a mut T }
expression: No equivalent DSL expression exists: the grammar cannot express termination of a reborrow or prohibit future use of its derived pointers and references.
